faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) for filling up project-based positions in the state of Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Indore?
faq.answer: IIT Indore has advertised for the position of Research Project Specialist under this recruitment notification released for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Project Specialist post. Interested candidates should apply before the final deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore Research Project Specialist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Research Project Specialist position at IIT Indore is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Project Specialist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Civil Engineering/Environmental Engineering along with proficiency in relevant technical tools, MS Office, LaTeX, MATLAB, and Python.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Project Specialist position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000 as per the institutional norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories as per the official recruitment details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Indore Research Project Specialist?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Project Specialist position primarily involves an Interview scheduled to be held on 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications through the online mode by visiting the official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Indore.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of IIT Indore?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of IIT Indore at https://www.iiti.ac.in to access the application portal, official notifications, and further updates.
